name: Flight Practice
brief: We will begin by teaching some basics of space flight and hyperspacing. In normal flight, use the direction keys to move your ship. To start training, you will have to travel to a Confederate system, then return here. To do this, access your map by pressing "m" once you have left ConEx. Then, find the system with the red arrow pointing to it. To move toward that system, select a system adjecent to Levo in the direction of the arrow on the map and press OK. Move away from the planet and press "j" to jump. Once you have entered the next system, you can land on the planet, or move to another system adjecent to that one. When you have reached the destination system, <DSY>, marked with the red arrow, land on the correct planet, <DST>, then return to the Flight Academy to complete the mission. Hail Cap'n Twinkie if you need any help. Good luck.
quickBrief: Fly to <DST>, land, then return to <RST>. Hail the flight overseer if you need assistance.
compText: Good work. We hope this first training session helped you to learn the basics of space flight. Your next assignment will be to purchase a new ship. Enter the Spaceport Bar to continue training.

name: Start Freight Training
brief: The first stages of training involve commerce and trading. To begin, the ConEx is giving you the money to purchase a Light Freighter. Leave ConEx, then land again and purchase the Light Freighter.
quickBrief: Leave ConEx, then land and purchase a Light Freighter.
compText: Purchase a Light Freighter by selecting Visit Shipyard. Your Shuttlecraft will be traded in. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you have purchased the ship. Remember, purchase a Light Freighter only.

name: Shipping 101
brief: Travel to <DST> in the <DSY> system, land there to pickup the <CT>, and return to the Academy. You have one month to complete this mission and it pays 10,000 credits. Remember to stop to refuel when necessary. One of our Academy training Overseers will be following you all the way. If you need help, hail him by targeting his ship and pressing the "Y" key (unless changed in preferences). Press "Greetings" and he will assist you. Good luck.
quickBrief: Travel to <DST>, pickup the cargo by landing, then return to <RST>. Misson Deadling: <DL>. Hail the Training Overseer if you need any help.
compText: Good work for your first mission. You have earned 10,000 credits for successful delivery. That is one the basic types of mission you will get from the Mission Computer. In most cases, you will not have to return to the original planet where you accepted the mission, however. The other type of mission is ferrying passengers, which works similarly. When you are ready to continue training, return to the Spaceport Bar here on ConEx

name: Shipping 202
brief: Travel to <DST> in the <DSY> system, land there to pickup the <CT>, and return to ConEx. You have one month to complete this mission and it pays 20,000 credits. In this mission, you will have to avoid, outrun, or destroy the Academy training ships. Their weapons will not harm your ship, but they will provide a realistic simulation of combat. By this time, you should have enough money to purchase an Afterburner. This device will allow you to escape dangerous situations by allowing your ship to reach high speeds. Before you leave Levo, we suggest you visit the "Outfit Ship" area and purchase an afterburner. To use it, press "z". Your ship will speed up in the direction you are pointing. Remember, our overseer will accompany you. Hail him if you need help.
quickBrief: Travel to <DST>, pickup the cargo by landing, then return to <RST>. Mission Deadline: <DL>. Hail the Training Overseer if you need any help.
compText: Good job. You have successfully delivered your cargo, and hopefully got a feel for combat. Your next mission will teach you about trading on the Commodity Exchange. Enter the Spaceport Bar when you are ready.

name: Trading 101
brief: The key to making profit on the commodity exchange is buying low and selling high. In the Commodity Exchange window, this information is given next to the prices of items. In this mission, you will start at <DST> in the <DSY> system. Check <DST>'s Commodity Exchange and find out what goods they trade. Then, select adjecent systems on your map to find out what goods they trade, if any. Find adjecent systems that have planets that trade the same goods as <DST>, and check the prices. Buy a specific commodity low on one planet, then sell it high on another. Buy as much as you can low, and sell it all high. You have 60 days to complete this mission, but you may terminate it at any time by returning to <RST>. Do not abort the mission to end it, and make sure you return to <RST> before <DL>. Landing on <RST> will terminate the mission. Remember to hail the Overseer if you need any assistance.
quickBrief: Fly to <DST>, land, and check the commodity exchange. Find adjecent systems trading in the same goods and check their prices. Trade as long as you wish before <DL>. Return to <RST> before <DL> or the mission will fail.
compText: We hope this mission gave you some experience in trading on the Commodity Exchange. Your next mission will go further in-dept in making money on the exchange.

name: Trading 202
brief: This mission will be similar to that last. You must fly to <DST>, land, and check the commodity exchange. The Academy has rigged a disaster, changing the price of one of the commodities. Take advantage of this change by finding another world that sells that commodity at a lower price. You should also have enough money to purchase an escort for this mission. After you have finished reading this message, select "Hire Escort" from the Spaceport Bar. Hire a Courier. The price at the bottom is the ship's daily charge. The Academy has given you enough money to sustain this escort for a period of time. When you are ready to finish the mission, release the escort by targeting him (by pressing opt-tab until the ship is selected), hailing him ("y"), and selecting "Release from Servitude." Then, return to Levo to complete the mission. The time limit is 60 days, byt you may terminate earlier by landing on Levo.
quickBrief: Hire a Courier escort, fly to New Britain, trade, then return to Levo by <DL>. Release the escort before finishing the mission by hailing him (opt-tab to select) and selecting "Release from Servitude."
compText: Excellent work. This completes the Trading & Commerce Section of the Academy Flight Training. The next section deals with combat. Return to the Spaceport Bar to continue training.

name: Start Combat Training
brief: Good. Before you begin the combat training, you will need a new ship. The Academy is providing you the money to purchase a Lightning. To do so, leave ConEx, then land again. You will recieve the money and further instructions then.
quickBrief: Land on ConEx and purchase a Lightning.
compText: Now that you have the money, you can purchase the Lightning that will be used in this stage of training. First, however, it is advisable that you sell all your current upgrades. When ships are sold, the upgrades that are on the previous ship are not transferred to the next. Before visiting the shipyard, go to "Outfit Ship" and sell as much as you can. Then, select "Visit Shipyard" and purchase a Lightning. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you have purchased the ship.

name: Upgrade Ship
brief: The Academy will give you 60,000 credits to purchase an Afterburner, a Density Scanner, an IFF Decoder, an Escape Pod, and an Auto-Ejection System. As done before, please leave Levo then land again.
quickBrief: Leave ConEx then land again to purchase upgrade items.
compText: Enter the Outfit Ship area and purchase an Afterburner, a Density Scanner, an IFF Decoder, an Escape Pod, and an Auto-Ejection System. These five items should always be added to every ship you purchase. Read the information on each in the Outfit area. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you are done.

name: Combat 101
brief: Your first assignment is to destroy an Academy ship. Its weapons will do you no damage and its shields are not at full power. It will be attacking you as well, so try not to be hit by its weapons. Your ship is very maneuverable, so try not to overshoot the enemy or overmaneuver the ship. Your laser cannon fires straight in the direction of your ship. Try to make sure you can hit the enemy without hitting anyone else before firing. You should also make use of the new items your ship has. To detect where your enemy is, find the red dot on your radar screen. Larger dots indicate bigger ships. Blue dots indicate friendly ships, and green ones indicate escorts. Use your afterburner if you need to outrun or catch up with your enemy quicky. If your ship begins to explode, your auto-ejection system will launch your escape pod. Remember, if you need help, hail the Overseer and select "Greetings" for advice, and "Request Assistance" for help. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy Academy training ship, then return to <RST>.
compText: Good work for your first combat mission. Now that you have experienced some first-hand combat, the training sessions will increase in difficulty and danger. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you are ready to continue.

name: Combat 102
brief: Combat 102 is similar to Combat 101, but there are more ships to destroy. Destroy all enemy ships, then return to ConEx.
quickBrief: Destroy enemy ships and return to ConEx.
compText: Excellent job, <PN>. You will find that as you advance through the training, the enemies become more difficult and the missions more complex. Your next mission will increase the difficulty level. Enter the Spaceport Bar when you are ready for it.

name: Combat 103
brief: This mission requires that you destroy four Academy target ships in this system, but this time their weapons will do some damage to your ship. Make sure you avoid their fire while trying to destroy them. Try not to hit any other ships, however, for they may begin to attack you as well. Watch your shields - if you run into trouble, land on Levo. Your shields will be recharged, and when you leave, you will be able to continue the mission. Remember only shoot at the ships that are RED.
quickBrief: Destroy Academy target ships in ConEx sector, then return to ConEx.
compText: Excellent work. Your skills have improved greatly. Now that you have the basic skills of combat, your next set of missions will introduce the next level. Enter the Spaceport Bar when you are ready to continue training.

name: New Combat Ship
brief: The next ship you will must purchase is a Rapier. To do so, leave ConEx, then land again. You will recieve the money and further instructions then.
quickBrief: Land on ConEx and purchase a Rapier.
compText: Now that you have the money, you can purchase the Rapier that will be used in this stage of training. First, however, it is advisable that you sell all your current upgrades. When ships are sold, the upgrades that are on the previous ship are not transferred to the next. Before visiting the shipyard, go to "Outfit Ship" and sell as much as you can. Then, select "Visit Shipyard" and purchase a Rapier. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you have purchased the ship.

name: Upgrade Ship
brief: The Academy will give you 100,000 credits to purchase Armaplast Plating, an Afterburner, a Density Scanner, an IFF Decoder, an Escape Pod, and an Auto-Ejection System. As done before, please leave ConEx then land again.
quickBrief: Leave ConEx then land again to purchase upgrade items.
compText: Enter the Outfit Ship area and purchase a layer of Armaplast plating, an Afterburner, a Density Scanner, an IFF Decoder, an Escape Pod, and an Auto-Ejection System. These six items should always be added to every ship you purchase. Read the information on each in the Outfit area. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you are done.

name: Combat 201
brief: With your new ship, a Rapier, you will learn new combat techniques. You will notice that you have two secondary weapons: torpedos and heavy rockets. Torpedos are farily accurate and powerful, and good at close or long range. Torpedos should be used if you cannot see the ship visually, but only on radar. They work by selecting a target, then selecting "Torpedos," and pressing "q" to fire. Heavy rockets are innacurate but very powerful, and only good at close range. The same procedure is used to fire Heavy Rockets as Torpedos. This ship also has a rear laser turret. This type of weapon does not require you to be pointing at a ship, only that it is targeted and behind you. It is a primary weapon, fired with the space bar. This mission requires that you destroy two Academy target ships, both with harmless weapons. Report back to Levo when you have completed the mission. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy the two Academy target ships, then return to ConEx. Hail the Overseer if you need help.
compText: Good work. Your skills are improving greatly. Your next mission will be a little tougher. You probably used some of your secondary weapons, so it is advisable that you visit the Outfit Ship area to purchase more torpedos and rockets. Report back to the Spaceport Bar when you are ready to continue training.

name: Combat 202
brief: This mission will require you to destroy three ConEx target ships that are minimally armed. These ships are not as difficult as real ships you will encounter in space, but their weapons can do you damage. Remember to use your secondary weapons and to watch your shields. Hail the Overseer for help, or land on  ConEx if you feel you will be destroyed. If you are, you will be safely ejected, but you will need to purchase another ship with the left-over money. If you have not added more torpedos or rockets to your ship, do so before leaving ConEx. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy the Academy target ships, then return to ConEx.
compText: Good job. Restock your ship and return to the Spaceport Bar to continue training.

name: Combat 203
brief: In this training session, you will have to destroy a new type of ship, a Corvette. This Corvette, however, is a weakened version, similar to the previous ships you have faced. It is still more dangerous than the others, though. The Corvette has Proton Turrets, which are more powerful and dangerous than Lasers or Laser Turrets. It also is equipped with Heavy Rockets, Missiles, and Javelin Rockets. Make sure you have restocked your ship with weapons. Destroy the Corvette and return to ConEx. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy the target Corvette then return to ConEx.
compText: Excellent work. Your next mission will involve hunting ships in other systems. Enter the Spaceport Bar when you are ready.

name: Combat 204
brief: The target ship is another Corvette of the same type you destroyed in your last mission. It is in a system adjecent to Levo. Find the ship, destroy it, then return to Levo. Make sure you have restocked your weapons before departing. The Overseer will be with you to help if necessary. Good luck.
quickBrief: Find target Corvette, destroy it, then return to ConEx.
compText: Good work, <PN>. You are now ready for the next level of Combat training. When you are ready to begin, enter the ConEx Spaceport Bar.

name: New Combat Ship
brief: The next ship you will must purchase is a Corvette. To do so, leave ConEx, then land again. You will recieve the money and further instructions then.
quickBrief: Land on ConEx and purchase a Corvette.
compText: Now that you have the money, you can purchase the Corvette that will be used in this stage of training. First, however, it is advisable that you sell all your current upgrades. When ships are sold, the upgrades that are on the previous ship are not transferred to the next. Before visiting the shipyard, go to "Outfit Ship" and sell as much as you can. Then, select "Visit Shipyard" and purchase a Corvette. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you have purchased the ship.

name: Upgrade Ship
brief: ConEx will give you 200,000 credits to purchase any items you wish. You can also buy Mass Expansions, which take space from your cargo section and allocate it to the weapons section. We strongly recommend that you purchase only one of these items, if any. All others items are at your discression, but we again recommend the IFF Decoder, the Density Scanner, the Armaplast, the Escape Pod, the Auto-Eject, and the Afterburner. As done before, please leave ConEx then land again.
quickBrief: Land on ConEx and upgrade your ship.
compText: Enter the "Outfit Ship" area and purchase items of your choice. Remember, use your credits wisely and don't buy items you don't need. Also make sure you don't purchase too may Mass Expansions, because they cannot be sold. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you are ready to return to training.

name: Combat 300
brief: Before we begin with new work, you should get a feel for your new ship. This mission requires that you destroy the two target Academy ships in this system, then return to ConEx.
quickBrief: Destroy the target ships in the ConEx System then return to ConEx.
compText: Now that you have experienced flight and battle with your Corvette, we will begin this phase of training. Restock your ship if necessary then return to the Spaceport Bar when you are ready to continue training.

name: Combat 301
brief: This mission will require you to destroy an Academy target Kestrel in Levo space. The Kestrel itself will be at half-power, but its fighters will be fully armed. For missions such as this, where you must destroy the ship, we recommed that you go after the Kestrel first and avoid its fighters if possible. It is not necessary to destroy fighters in most missions of this type. When you have destroyed the Kestrel, return to ConEx. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy target Kestrel then return to ConEx.
compText: You successfully managed to destroy the Kestrel. This is the type of combat you will face in more advanced missions, bounty hunting, and pirate fighting (note: it's always good to destroy or disable and board pirates. This actually raises your standing with respectable governments.). Restock your ship and return to the Spaceport Bar to continue training.

name: Combat 302
brief: This mission involves boarding ships. To board a ship, first you must disable it. Disabling a ship involves attacking it, but not to the point of destroying it. When a ship is disabled, its boarder becomes gray, as does its dot on the radar screen. It is important that you do not inflict massive damage to the ship when it has very low shields (<5%, except with big ships like Frigates or Cruisers), because you may destroy it accidentally. When a ship has very low shields or no shields, you should use your guns or turrets only to disable it. Larger weapons may destroy the ship.  After it is disabled, move to the ship and try to match its speed. Then, overlay your ship with the disabled one and align your hull to match its. Then, press "b" to board the ship. After a few tries, you should be able to board the ship. In this mission, you will be removing <CT> from the ship. When you have completed the mission, return the <CT> to Levo. Good luck.
quickBrief: Board the target Academy ship, then return to Levo.
compText: Good work! Normally when you board a ship, you will be presented with options: Capture Ship, Leave, or steal Cargo, Fuel, Credits, or Ammo. The probability of capturing the ship is also presented in the form of a percentage. This is determined by the difference in sizes of the ship's crews. A larger ship is more likely to be able to capture a smaller ship. However, when you steal one or more of the items above, your chances of capturing the ship decrease. When you are ready to continue training, restock your ship and return to the Spaceport Bar.

name: Combat 303
brief: Escorting ships involves taking them safely to their destination. Sometimes, you may need to destroy attacking ships or simply jump out of a system quickly. This mission will require you to escort three Light Freighters to <RST>. Their dots on your radar screen will be large and green. Two of our Academy ships will be following you, trying to destroy the Light Freighters. Either destroy the persuing Academy ships or jump between systems before they can destroy the Freighters. You may land to refuel between jumps. This action also recharges the Freighters' shields, so it may be advisable if one or more of them are damaged. If any of the ships are destroyed, the mission will fail. To complete the mission, land on <RST>. Good luck.
quickBrief: Escort Light Freighters to <RST>.
compText: Congratulations! All the ships made it to their destination safely. Nearly all escort work is very similar to the mission you just finished. Now return to ConEx for further training.

name: Combat 304
brief: This mission will involve hiring a Rapier as an escort and using it to help you defeat two Academy Corvettes in the Levo System. First, visit the Spaceport Bar and select "Hire An Escort." Hire a Rapier using the money the Academy has been giving you. Then, leave the planet and engage the Corvettes. You must destroy both ships. To command your escort, press "c" for it to join you in formation and "v" for it to hold position and stop attacking unless it is attacked (useful when you wish to board a ship, not destroy it). Escorts such as Rapiers and Lightnings will always attack any enemy in the system. Others, such as Clippers and Light Freighters will only attack when attacked themselves. When you have destroyed the ships, select the escort by pressing "alt-tab" until selected. Then press " y" to communicate, and select "Release from Servitude." Return to Levo when you are done. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy the two Corvettes with the aid of an escort. Release the escort, then return to Levo.
compText: Excellent work. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you are ready to continue training.

name: New Combat Ship
brief: The next ship you will must purchase is a Kestrel. To do so, leave ConEx, then land again. You will recieve the money and further instructions then.
quickBrief: Land on ConEx and purchase a Kestrel.
compText: Now that you have the money, you can purchase the Kestrel that will be used in this stage of training. First, however, it is advisable that you sell all your current upgrades. When ships are sold, the upgrades that are on the previous ship are not transferred to the next. Before visiting the shipyard, go to "Outfit Ship" and sell as much as you can. Then, select "Visit Shipyard" and purchase a Kestrel. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you have purchased the ship.

name: Upgrade Ship
brief: ConEx will give you 500,000 credits to purchase any items you wish. This time, we suggest you purchase a Missile Jammer in addition to the items listed below. This device will be most useful in avoiding missles launched from enemy ships. You can also buy Mass Expansions, which take space from your cargo section and allocate it to the weapons section. We strongly recommend that you purchase only few of these items, if any. All others items are at your discression, but we again recommend the IFF Decoder, the Density Scanner, the Armaplast, the Escape Pod, the Auto-Eject, and the Afterburner. As done before, please leave Levo then land again.
quickBrief: Land on Levo and upgrade your ship.
compText: Enter the "Outfit Ship" area and purchase items of your choice. Remember, use your credits wisely and don't but items you don't need. Also make sure you don't purchase too may Mass Expansions, because they cannot be sold. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you are ready to return to training.

name: Advanced Combat 1
brief: This mission will require that you destroy two fully outfitted and operational Corvettes. These are the types of ships you will find when traveling the galaxy. You will also have at your disposal two Lightning Strike Fighters, which are stored in your Lightning Bay. To use them, press "w" until Lightning Bay appears in the Secondary Weapon window. Launch them with "Shift", or your Fire Secondary key. When both have been launched, select a target, then press "f" to have your fighters attack that target. Press "v" to have your fighters hold position, "c" to have them regroup in formation, and "opt-c" to have them return to their bays. When you have destroyed the two ships, return to Levo. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy the two Corvettes then return to ConEx.
compText: Good work! You have successfully destroyed the two Corvettes, and hopefully learned how to use fighters. Restock your ship, then return to the Spaceport Bar when you're ready to continue training.

name: Advanced Combat 2
brief: The Frigate is in this system (ConEx). Destroy it, then return to the Spaceport Bar. A good idea when taking on large ships is to stay out of visual range while firing Torpedos and Missiles at it. Let your fighters engage in close combat at first. Keep moving around so to avoid its missiles (a Missile Jammer and Afterburner will help) and torpedos. When the ship's shields are getting low (around 30%), move in closer and use more Torpedos, Missiles, and Heavy Rockets while avoiding the ship's fire. Also make use of your turrets and other secondary weapons. Return to Levo when you have destroyed the ship. Good luck.
quickBrief: Destroy Frigate in ConEx System then return to ConEx.
compText: Congratulations! You have successfully destroyed a Frigate. Even though this ship was weakened somewhat, it was still quite powerful. A real Frigate, or its Rebel counterpart, the Destroyer, is more difficult to defeat with a single Kestrel and fighters, but possible. We will not move on to the Cruiser, because the Academy does not wish to stir suicidal tendencies in its trainees. We strongly urge that you do not attempt to take on such a ship without a large complement of fighters and fighter-escorts. Your next missions will involve more combat and mission skills. Return to the Spaceport Bar when ready.

name: Final Training 1
brief: The first part of your mission is to take these orders to Mars by <DL>. There, you will receive further instructions.
quickBrief: Deliver orders to Mars by <DL>.
compText: You have successfully completed the first part of this mission. Report to the Spaceport Bar for further instructions.

name: Final Training 2
brief: Escort the five Light Freighters that will be arriving here shortly to <RST> in the <RSY> system by <DL>. You will receive further instructions there.
quickBrief: Escort Freighters to <RST> by <DL>.
compText: Good work. All the Freighters have arrived unharmed. Report to the Spaceport Bar here on <RST> for further instructions.

name: Final Training 3
brief: It was discovered from the orders you transported from the Academy and the Freighters you escorted that a fleet of Freighters are planning to dump toxic material on ConEx. They will be traveling through the Zebetrious system. Go to the Zebetrious system, destroy the Freighters, and return to <RST> by <DL>. You may have to Warp in and out before you kill all the the Light FreightersGood luck.
quickBrief: Destroy freighters in Zebetrious system, then return to <RST> by <DL>.
compText: Good work! You managed to save ConEx from certain disaster. This was your last mission, as well. Congratulations! You graduated from the Levo Flight Academy. Report to the Spaceport Bar on Levo for your diploma further advice.

name: Final Training 4
brief: It appears the attackers have a number of ships. Two of our ships will be assisting you. Good luck.
quickBrief: Defend ConEx from the Attackers.
compText: Good work. That was the final exam, the last stage of Academy training. You have passed and are now ready to survive in this treacherous galaxy. You can move on to trading or bounty hunting, and align yourself with the Confederation, the Rebellion, or neither. The Academy is a neutral party, so we cannot help in this process. The Kestrel you have is yours to keep, as well as the credits. You may choose to start a new game, or continue with the current one.  Your ship, weapons, credits, and other items will remain with you.Hopefully this training and experience has prepared you for just about anything.

name: Massive cargo transport
brief: “Great!... All you have to do is go to <DST> in the <DSY> system and pick up the wood. Then Travel to <RST> in the <RSY> system.
quickBrief: Pick up <CQ> at <DST>, then take it to <RST>
compText: “Good work <PN> Meet me in the bar, for I need another favor from you.”

name: Massive Cargo Escort
brief: He tells you to set at a table. “I need you to transport the Loggs to <dst> in the <dsy> system”. A man walks up and says I am the securty officer that will be monitering your actions while you are going to <dst>.”You hop onto your ship and take off.
compText: “It is great doing buisness with you, you are now considered an offical member of Marks Logging transportation. Meet me in the bar for an other assingment.”

name: Escort massive transport
brief: “All you have to do is Escort/observe the 6 ships that I don’t trust yet. follow them to <DST> in the <DSY> system, before <DL>
quickBrief: Escort 6 ships to <DST> in the <DSY system, before <DL>
compText: As the airlock open you see a man. “Nice to see you again” Fred Marks comments. “You are now considered a employee for Marks Construction.  If you ever are in need of some money, stop by at New Japan in the Pollux system (below Tau Ceti). Each shipment will pay 500,000, and 4 out of 5 times you stop by I will have a job for you.

name: Massive Lumber Transport
brief: “OK,  we will load the wood onto your ship <SN> and then your ready to take off. Go to <DST> in the <DSY> System, before <DL>There you will find you payment. Good luck.”
quickBrief: Transport <CT> of <CQ> to <DST> in the <DSY> before <DL>
compText: “Thank you for doing operations for us. remember, you are considered an employee of Marks Construction. If you ever need a job, 4 out of 5 times I will have one waiting for you at New Japan.”

name: Approach School: The Corridor
brief: Trading 202 taught you to move goods. Now learn to arrive with them. Launch, request reentry, and FLY THE NEEDLE: hold the corridor band on the glideslope gauge. Steep burns the hull, shallow skips you back to orbit. Land back here inside the pipe and the school pays out.
quickBrief: Take off, fly the corridor needle, land back at ConEx.
compText: Inside the pipe, five by five. The corridor is the whole game — everything else is bookkeeping.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Approach School: Ride the Pillow
brief: The plasma sheath is not fire, it is the disposal process. Feed lithium with [ and ] to keep the mirror lit, watch FLUX/LIM and WALL K on the cluster, and mind the battery — the coil drinks the deep store while the radiators fly blind. Land with reserves and the margin is yours to keep.
quickBrief: Manage lithium feed and heat through one full entry.
compText: You steered the river instead of fighting it. That lithium you saved is money on the next ten landings.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Approach School: The Handoff
brief: Plasma authority dies with the speed; the airframe wakes with the air. Watch STEER on the panel — when aero passes plasma you are in the pipe, five by five, and the wing-shape coefficient opens to its 5:5 glide. Spend RCS gently: every commanded degree costs propellant, and a steep dive triples the bill.
quickBrief: Fly the plasma-to-aero handoff with RCS to spare.
compText: Clean handoff. A pilot who lands with dry bottles was never flying the approach — the approach was flying them.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Approach School: Hot and Steep
brief: The high-risk lesson. A steep, fast profile saves time and fuel — and charges for it: guardian seed dumps, hull scrub off the corridor, and if you are still supersonic under ten kilometres the port fines you for every window on the boulevard. Decide what the pad bonus is worth. That decision IS the trade.
quickBrief: Fly one deliberately hot profile and settle the bill.
compText: Now you know the price of speed to the decimal. Every landing from here on is a wager you size yourself.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Doctrine: The Courier
brief: Ship doctrine, lesson one. The Dart '97: 700 velocity, 1,600 mass, turns like a barge. It exists for exactly this — five tonnes of priority medicine, one hop out, one hop back, market closing. Light hull means a cool corridor; speed means the deadline is yours. Fly the plan, not the scenery.
quickBrief: Rush 5 t of medicine out and return — courier doctrine.
compText: That is what velocity is FOR. Small hold, cool entry, fast lanes: the courier lives on the spread between speed and mass.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Doctrine: The Pins
brief: The pins — 90 to 850 mass, quick on the pad, cheap to land. Ten tonnes of rations to a Confederation stellar, delivery only, no return leg. A pin's shallow ballistic coefficient makes every corridor forgiving: this is the hull you learn new planets in.
quickBrief: Deliver 10 t of rations one-way in a light hull.
compText: Delivered. Remember how gentle that entry was — mass is the thing the atmosphere actually charges for.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Doctrine: The Hauler
brief: The Tomaquad '97: 300 velocity, built like furniture. Forty tonnes of lumber, one way. Heavy and slow means a hot, narrow corridor — bank the battery before entry, feed early, and take the half bonus at ten kilometres rather than chase the line with a full hold. The hauler's profit is patience.
quickBrief: Haul 40 t of lumber one-way in a heavy hull.
compText: The hold pays for the heat. When the margin-per-tonne beats the repair-per-tonne, you are a freight captain.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Doctrine: The Escort Wing
brief: The Gryphon and Defender '97 banks: 800-900 velocity, real acceleration, hulls that can take a hit. Hire one at the bar (H), fly the pair out and back. Escorts are wages, and wages are a market position: carry the wing when the cargo is worth more than the payroll, pay it off when it is not.
quickBrief: Hire an escort, fly out and back with the wing.
compText: Wing discipline holds. You just learned the escort trade from the buying side — remember it when you sell.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Doctrine: The Freighter
brief: Graduation hull: the Yodacon '97. 600 velocity, 350 tonnes — the same 350 tonnes the reentry envelope was built around. Sixty tonnes of chips out, full-margin return. Everything the school taught lands at once: the corridor, the feed, the handoff, the wager. Bring her down on the line.
quickBrief: Fly the Yodacon on a full-hold chips run, out and back.
compText: On the line, on the numbers. The freighter is not a ship, it is a balance sheet with a corridor rating.
restoration: 2026 Approach School — extends the 1997 academy chain past Trading 202, instead of Start Combat Training.

name: Rags to Riches
brief: No cargo attached: the school hands you the board instead. Read the wire at the trade centre, find the event — the plague, the strike, the glut — buy low here, sell high there, and land well enough to keep it. The school's last payment is seed capital. The rest of the galaxy is the syllabus now.
quickBrief: Work the commodity board across one round trip.
compText: Class dismissed. From portable classroom to the plasma pillow: the ship procession is yours to fly.
